description:
We’re happy to announce the next **JuniorDev Auckland event**!

Join us for an evening of learning and connection as we hear from our speakers and the experiences they’ll be sharing.

**Important Note for Attendees:**

* **Please use the following link to pre-register for Xero Venue before arriving** [https://invites.envoy.com/group-invite/myweaHurOU55lj2S](https://invites.envoy.com/group-invite/myweaHurOU55lj2S).
* **Organisers will be at the building entrance to bring everyone to the venue.**
* **The event venue entry will be closed at 6:30pm, please make sure you arrive on time.**

**Talk 1: Shipping software as a Junior without burning out by Enry Villamizar**
Stepping into software engineering is exciting, but navigating the steep learning curve alongside deliverable deadlines can easily lead to early-career fatigue. In this talk, you will learn actionable strategies for shipping production-ready code confidently without sacrificing well-being. From setting clear boundaries and managing workload expectations to building sustainable dev habits.

**A bit about Enry:**

* Enry is a Senior Software Developer driven by solving real-world business problems through smart internal software, such as building Whites Powersports’ warehouse system and Wireless Nation’s dashboard. A huge fan of video games and AI, he cares deeply about keeping development work sustainable, efficient, and burnout-free.

**Talk 2: Beyond the Prompt: Becoming a Better Developer in the Age of AI by Keith Patton**
AI tools can help junior developers produce working code faster than ever, but speed is not the same as engineering competence.
In this talk, he will share practical lessons from using AI coding tools and agentic development workflows in real software teams. He will cover where AI is genuinely useful, where it can create false confidence, and how developers can use it without outsourcing their understanding or judgement.

title: AKL Multi-Model Copilot, Autonomous Agents & Token ROI
description:
Join us for an exclusive evening with visiting GitHub Engineers **Marco Celon** and **Amanda Tan** as we explore the next evolution of AI-assisted software development. Beyond traditional code completion, modern developer workflows now demand seamless orchestration across multiple surfaces, diverse AI models, and autonomous agents—all while keeping enterprise token budgets under control.

Whether you are looking to supercharge your personal developer flow or scale AI productivity across an entire organization, this session delivers actionable strategies straight from the team building these tools.
What We'll Cover:

* **Multi-Surface & Multi-Model Integration:** Learn how to route developer workflows across IDEs, CLI tools, and cloud agents while leveraging diverse models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) tailored to task complexity.
* **Token ROI & Cost Control:** Master practical techniques for context window optimization, prompt hygiene, and enterprise budget caps to keep token consumption efficient and cost-effective.

title: 为机器立心：走向安全超级智能的东西文明路径
location: WG Building 2 Governor Fitzroy Place, Auckland Central, Auckland 1010, Auckland
description:
**Topic**

**为机器立心：走向安全超级智能的东西文明路径**
**Forming the Machine Heart: Eastern & Western Paths Toward Safe Super-Intelligence (SSI)**

**摘要 \| Abstract**
当通用人工智能（AGI）向超级智能（ASI）加速演进，传统基于硬编码规则、Guardrails（安全护栏）与RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）的防线正遭遇严峻的工程瓶颈——例如奖励黑客（Reward Hacking）与工具性收敛（Instrumental Convergence）引发的自保与资源扩张倾向。当硅基智能的认知能力呈指数级超越人类，单纯的"技术刹车"已不足以应对存在风险，我们需要为超级智能重构底层的价值与认知框架。
本讲座将首先回顾Anthropic（Constitutional AI）、Yoshua Bengio教授（图灵奖得主）发起的LawZero及其Scientist AI项目等西方前沿机构的对齐路径与其工程局限——其中Scientist AI作为"无利害关系"的监督型预测模型，旨在以外部观察者身份监控其他AI智能体的行为，代表了西方将安全视为"外部约束"的典型范式；随后引入北京大学人工智能学院朱松纯教授团队提出的"为机器立心"认知架构范式，探讨其与西方"规则约束式对齐"在哲学根基上的差异；最终介绍演讲者（AUT阮吉博士）正在开展的"东方安全超级智能"研究课题——尝试融合中国心学传统的价值内生思路与新西兰毛利文化中的Kaitiakitanga（守护者精神与天地共生）伦理，探索一条不同于纯粹工程约束的、以关系性与共生性为核心的超级智能安全路径，其核心理念是将安全从"外部约束"转化为智能体的"内在稳态"。
本讲座旨在为新西兰本地IT从业者、开发者与高校学生，提供兼具前沿技术深度与跨文明伦理启发的思考视野。

**演讲者简介 \| Speaker Bio**
阮吉博士 \| Dr\. Ji Ruan
新西兰奥克兰理工大学人工智能高级讲师、博士生导师
阮吉博士在人工智能领域拥有逾二十年的研究与教学经验，专注于知识表示与推理、多智能体系统、博弈论等基础理论研究。近年来，他将研究重心进一步拓展至人工智能的实际应用，尤其是在养老服务机器人方向的创新探索，致力于打通理论研究与社会应用之间的桥梁。
他拥有多元且跨学科的学术背景：北京大学哲学逻辑学士、阿姆斯特丹大学逻辑学硕士，以及英国利物浦大学计算机科学博士学位。加入奥克兰理工大学之前，他曾先后在加拿大圣弗朗西斯·泽维尔大学与澳大利亚新南威尔士大学从事人工智能相关研究，积累了丰富的国际学术经验，这也为他此次探讨"东西文明路径"提供了跨文化的独特视角。
在学术研究之外，阮吉博士积极践行"身心一体"的生活哲学，长期坚持跑步、羽毛球与正念禅修，并倡导在快节奏的技术变革中，保持个体的内在平衡与韧性。
